metadata.subject: Algorithms
metadata.title: Discover Linear Search
metadata.description: Search from the beginning by comparing one value at a time.

learning_objectives: Start a search at the first value.
Explain why each comparison moves one position forward.

mission.title: Search one by one
mission.description: Compare each value from left to right until the target is found or the array ends.

introduction.title: Linear Search checks each value in order
introduction.content: Linear Search starts at the beginning and compares the target with every value until it finds a match or reaches the end.
points: The first comparison is at index 0.
A non-match moves the search one place right.
The search can finish with FOUND or NOT FOUND.

worked_example.title: Find 38 from the left
worked_example.content: A linear search never skips a still-unchecked value.

steps.explanation: 12 is not 38, so continue to the next position.
25 is not 38, so the search keeps moving right.
38 matches the target, so the search stops immediately.

worked_example.conclusion: The number of comparisons depends on where the target appears, or on checking the whole array when it is absent.

next.title: Now search the array.
next.content: Watch the highlighted comparison move from left to right.

next-step: The search starts at the first index.
This value does not match, so the next comparison moves one position right.
The highlighted value matches the target, so Linear Search stops.
Every value was checked, so the target is not present.

prediction.heading: Before the next comparison…
prediction.question: Which value will Linear Search check next?
prediction.selection_message: Your prediction: {prediction}. Continue the search to check it.
prediction.pending_message: Predict the next comparison before searching again.
prediction.required_message: Choose the next value Linear Search will inspect.

result.actual: Linear Search checks {actual} next, moving one position right.

steps: MOVE RIGHT ONE AT A TIME

actions.label: Check the first value
actions.task: Inspect the highlighted value and choose FOUND or CONTINUE.

actions.label: Continue right
actions.task: If it is not the target, continue one position to the right.

actions.label: Compare the target
actions.task: Compare the highlighted value with the target before deciding.

actions.label: Find the target
actions.task: Choose FOUND when the highlighted value matches the target.

challenge.title: Linear Search challenge
challenge.start_message: Find the target by checking values from left to right.
challenge.continue_message: Challenge complete. Try another search in free play.

phases.title: Find 50
phases.instruction: Check each value in order until the target is found.
phases.feedback: Start at the highlighted value and move right one position after each non-match.

guidance.start_message: Use the highlighted value and choose the next correct decision.

items.content: If the value is not the target, choose CONTINUE and move one position right.

phases.title: Find 36
phases.instruction: Choose CONTINUE for non-matches and FOUND when the target is highlighted.
phases.feedback: Only the highlighted value can be compared next.

guidance.start_message: Search this new array without the hint.

phases.title: Find 7
phases.instruction: Stop as soon as the first value matches the target.
phases.feedback: The first value is already the target, so do not continue.

guidance.start_message: This target is absent. Prove it by reaching the end.

phases.title: Prove 41 is absent
phases.instruction: Continue through every value, then choose NOT FOUND.
phases.feedback: There is still a highlighted candidate; only choose NOT FOUND after the final comparison.

phases.title: Master the scan
phases.instruction: Reach the target using only left-to-right comparisons.
phases.feedback: Linear Search advances one position at a time.

thinking.title: Predict the scan
thinking.instruction: Mentally trace the comparisons before searching.
thinking.do_not_execute: Do not advance the playground yet. Follow the scan from left to right.

prediction_fields.label: Compared values
prediction_fields.prompt: Which values will be compared, in order?

prediction_fields.label: Final result
prediction_fields.prompt: Will the target be FOUND or NOT FOUND?

feedback.incorrect: Start at index 0 and stop at the first match or after the last value.

solve.title: Expert Linear Search
solve.instruction: Find or rule out the target with no hints.
solve.perfect_result: You stopped at exactly the first match or final comparison.

discovery.title: Linear Search discovery
discovery.summary: Linear Search trades simplicity for potentially many comparisons by checking values in order.

sections.title: What?
sections.content: Linear Search checks values one by one from the beginning.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: To find 38 in [12, 25, 38], compare 12, then 25, then 38.

sections.title: Why?
sections.content: It works even when the values are not sorted, but it may inspect the whole array.

sections.title: Remember
sections.content: Start left → compare → move right → stop at FOUND or the end.

alternate_explanations.title: Think of checking tickets
alternate_explanations.content: A person checks tickets from the front of a line until the matching name appears.

alternate_explanations.title: Walk through it
alternate_explanations.content: Find 50 in [12, 25, 38, 50]: compare the first three, then stop when 50 matches.

recall.title: Recall
recall.prompt: In your own words, when does Linear Search stop?
recall.model_answer: It stops as soon as the target is found, or after the final value is checked and no match exists.
